description: Lesson i1: hal-blink with PA5 as an OPEN-DRAIN output (GPIO_MODE_OUTPUT_OD) - sinks only, needs a pull-up or an LED from 3V3
expect: 72 MHz, PA5 open-drain output (starts sinking: ODR 0) and PC13 push-pull (starts high, on-board LED off), both toggled every 501 ms (HAL_Delay(500) waits 501 ticks), PA5 first. While ODR5 = 1 the pin is released (high impedance): with a pull-up to 3V3 PA5 reads high, with only an LED + resistor to GND it stays near 0 V and the LED never lights; an LED + resistor from 3V3 into PA5 lights while PA5 sinks. With a 10 kOhm pull-up PA5 is a 501 ms / 501 ms square wave and PC13 = !PA5 (a few us apart: two separate toggles).
